issues.body: The repository policy says model-qualified source provenance markers such as `[OPUS-5]` are legacy and must migrate to `[SPARQ agent]` when touched. This diff removes `[OPUS-5]` entirely, leaving the source header without the required model-agnostic provenance marker.
issues.fix_hint: Replace `[OPUS-5]` with `[SPARQ agent]` on the header line, preserving the rest of the comment.
issues.title: Legacy provenance header is deleted instead of migrated

verdict.summary: The change removes a legacy model-qualified provenance marker but does not migrate it to the repository-required model-agnostic marker. The code behavior is otherwise untouched, but this provenance-only change is incomplete and conflicts with the standing source-header policy.
